summary: One church (Our Lady of Czestochowa, 120 Sussex St). Neither bulletin has a schedule box; the Masses come from the intentions of the Nov 8 and Nov 15 issues (R35), which agree with the parish website: Sat 5 PM, Sun 10 AM and 12:30 PM, Tue-Fri 12:30 PM, plus Friday 7 PM Adoration. No Confession time is printed in the bulletins or on the website. No open questions; no history stored.
